targets.rawQueryText: WITH l AS (SELECT (julianday(detected_at) - julianday(datetime(metar_ts, 'unixepoch'))) * 1440 AS lag FROM wb_signals WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', detected_at) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo() AND (julianday(detected_at) - julianday(datetime(metar_ts, 'unixepoch'))) * 1440 <= 30) SELECT round(lag, 1) AS lag FROM l ORDER BY lag LIMIT 1 OFFSET (SELECT count(*) / 2 FROM l)

panels.title: Would-buy signals (No below 99c) with market outcome

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT w.detected_at AS detected, w.city, w.date, w.label, w.observed_max AS metar_max, round((julianday(w.detected_at) - julianday(datetime(w.metar_ts, 'unixepoch'))) * 1440, 1) AS lag_min, w.no_best_ask AS no_ask, w.no_ask_size AS size, b.outcome AS yes_outcome, w.warning FROM wb_signals w JOIN buckets b ON b.market_id = w.market_id WHERE w.no_best_ask < 0.99 ORDER BY w.detected_at DESC LIMIT 200

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT m.station_id AS station, s.name, datetime(m.ts, 'unixepoch') AS observed_utc, m.temp_c, round((strftime('%s','now') - m.ts) / 60.0) AS age_min, substr(m.raw, 1, 90) AS raw FROM metar_live m JOIN (SELECT station_id, max(ts) AS ts FROM metar_live GROUP BY station_id) l ON l.station_id = m.station_id AND l.ts = m.ts LEFT JOIN stations s ON s.station_id = m.station_id ORDER BY m.station_id
